scientific_integrity: Proof supplied with analytic vertex-extremizer argument, trigonometric cap formula, and sharp shape-asymptotic coefficient. Finite checks corroborate but do not certify the infinite assertions. The disk and small-domain special cases are expressly treated as previously known.
scientific_limitations: Real affine degree-one L2 projection under uniform area on solid regular polygons only.
No theorem about monotonicity across all finite polygon orders or arbitrary polygon shapes.
Older hexagon polynomial literature was not available in complete full text; priority uncertainty remains.
title: Sharp affine least-squares projection norms on regular polygons and the disk-limit defect
